```{r}
variant_manifest <- data.frame(

        "PT_ID07", "PT_ID08", "PT_ID09", "PT_ID10", "PT_ID11", "PT_ID12",
        "PT_ID13", "PT_ID14", "PT_ID15", "PT_ID16", "PT_ID17", "PT_ID18",
        "PT_ID15_FU", "PT_ID19", "PT_ID20", "PT_ID20_FU"
    ),
    # Terminal barcode suffix, e.g. PT16 / PT15FU
    suffix = c(
        "PT01", "PT02", "PT03", "PT04", "PT05", "PT06",
        "PT07", "PT08", "PT09", "PT10", "PT11", "PT12",
        "PT13", "PT14", "PT15", "PT16", "PT17", "PT18",
        "PT15FU", "PT19", "PT20", "PT20FU"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(variant_manifest$sample_id))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(variant_manifest$prefix))


# ---- Barcode construction -----------------------------------------------------
# Target format:
#   Follow-up : PT_ID15_FU.ACCTTGAAGTGGTCGCTA_PT15FU
#   Baseline  : PT_ID16.CGCACTCTTCCATGATGT_PT16
build_ngt_barcodes <- function(ngt_df, prefix, suffix) {
    barcode <- rownames(ngt_df)

    if (is.null(barcode)) {
        stop("NGT data frame has no row names.")
    }

    barcode <- trimws(as.character(barcode))

    # Strip any prefix/suffix already present so the function is idempotent
    # regardless of whether the export wrote raw or annotated barcodes.
    barcode <- sub("^PT_ID[0-9]+(?:_FU)?\\.", "", barcode, perl = TRUE)
    barcode <- sub("^PT[0-9]+(?:_?FU)?\\.", "", barcode, perl = TRUE)
    barcode <- sub("^PT[0-9]+(?:_?FU)?_", "", barcode, perl = TRUE)
    barcode <- sub("_PT[0-9]+(?:_?FU)?$", "", barcode, perl = TRUE)

    if (any(!nzchar(barcode))) {
        stop(
            "Barcode stripping produced empty strings for ",
            sum(!nzchar(barcode)), " cell(s) in ", prefix,
            " — check the exported row-name format."
        )
    }

    new_barcodes <- paste0(prefix, ".", barcode, "_", suffix)

    if (anyDuplicated(new_barcodes)) {
        stop(
            "Duplicate NGT barcodes after renaming for ", prefix, ": ",
            paste(
                head(unique(new_barcodes[duplicated(new_barcodes)]), 5),
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    }

    rownames(ngt_df) <- new_barcodes

    ngt_df
}


# ---- Path to the exported NGT matrix -----------------------------------------
variant_matrix_path <- function(experiment, donor, layer = "NGT") {
    file.path(
        local_wd_folder,
        "results",
        "per_sample",
        experiment,
        donor,
        "dna_cnv",
        "variants",
        "all_variants",
        paste0(layer, "_all_variants.csv")
    )
}


# ---- Read one matrix, returning genotypes and any annotation columns ----------
read_variant_matrix <- function(path) {
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
        stop("Variant matrix not found: ", path)
    }

    df <- read.csv(
        path,
        header = TRUE,
        row.names = 1,          # first column holds the cell barcodes
        check.names = FALSE,    # preserve variant IDs, e.g. chr17:7577120:C/T
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    if (anyDuplicated(rownames(df))) {
        stop("Duplicate cell barcodes in ", path)
    }

    # Genotype columns are numeric; annotate = TRUE can append character metadata.
    is_genotype <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))

    if (!any(is_genotype)) {
        stop("No numeric genotype columns detected in ", path)
    }

    list(
        genotypes = df[, is_genotype, drop = FALSE],
        annotation = df[, !is_genotype, drop = FALSE],
        path = path
    )
}


# ---- Load every sample -------------------------------------------------------
NGT_list <- setNames(
    vector("list", nrow(variant_manifest)),
    variant_manifest$sample_id
)

NGT_annotation_list <- NGT_list
NGT_load_log <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(variant_manifest))) {
    sample_id <- variant_manifest$sample_id[i]

    message("Loading NGT for ", sample_id, " ...")

    matrix_path <- variant_matrix_path(
        experiment = variant_manifest$experiment[i],
        donor = variant_manifest$donor[i],
        layer = "NGT"
    )

    parsed <- read_variant_matrix(matrix_path)

    raw_example <- rownames(parsed$genotypes)[1]

    # PT_ID16.CGCACTCTTCCATGATGT_PT16 / PT_ID15_FU.ACCTTGAAGTGGTCGCTA_PT15FU
    ngt_df <- build_ngt_barcodes(
        parsed$genotypes,
        prefix = variant_manifest$prefix[i],
        suffix = variant_manifest$suffix[i]
    )

    NGT_list[[sample_id]] <- as.matrix(ngt_df)

    if (ncol(parsed$annotation) > 0) {
        # Keep annotation rows aligned to the renamed barcodes.
        annotation <- parsed$annotation
        rownames(annotation) <- rownames(ngt_df)
        NGT_annotation_list[[sample_id]] <- annotation
    }

    NGT_load_log[[sample_id]] <- data.frame(
        Sample = sample_id,
        Experiment = variant_manifest$experiment[i],
        Donor = variant_manifest$donor[i],
        n_cells = nrow(ngt_df),
        n_variants = ncol(ngt_df),
        n_annotation_cols = ncol(parsed$annotation),
        raw_barcode = raw_example,
        new_barcode = rownames(ngt_df)[1],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}

NGT_annotation_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), NGT_annotation_list)

NGT_load_summary <- do.call(rbind, NGT_load_log)
rownames(NGT_load_summary) <- NULL

print(NGT_load_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```

# 3. Load metadata

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Loading per-sample variant metadata
# ============================================================

# ---- Path to the exported metadata table --------------------------------------
variant_metadata_path <- function(experiment, donor) {
    file.path(
        local_wd_folder,
        "results",
        "per_sample",
        experiment,
        donor,
        "dna_cnv",
        "variants",
        "all_variants",
        "variant_metadata_all_variants.csv"
    )
}


# ---- Read one metadata table --------------------------------------------------
read_variant_metadata <- function(path) {
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
        stop("Variant metadata not found: ", path)
    }

    df <- read.csv(
        path,
        header = TRUE,
        row.names = 1,          # first column holds the variant IDs
        check.names = FALSE,    # preserve IDs, e.g. chr17:7577120:C/T
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    if (anyDuplicated(rownames(df))) {
        stop("Duplicate variant IDs in ", path)
    }

    df
}


# ---- Load every sample -------------------------------------------------------
variant_metadata_list <- setNames(
    vector("list", nrow(variant_manifest)),
    variant_manifest$sample_id
)

metadata_load_log <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(variant_manifest))) {
    sample_id <- variant_manifest$sample_id[i]

    message("Loading variant metadata for ", sample_id, " ...")

    metadata_file <- variant_metadata_path(
        experiment = variant_manifest$experiment[i],
        donor = variant_manifest$donor[i]
    )

    meta <- read_variant_metadata(metadata_file)

    # Carry sample provenance so the tables can be stacked later.
    meta$Sample <- sample_id
    meta$Experiment <- variant_manifest$experiment[i]
    meta$Donor <- variant_manifest$donor[i]
    meta$variant_id <- rownames(meta)

    variant_metadata_list[[sample_id]] <- meta

    metadata_load_log[[sample_id]] <- data.frame(
        Sample = sample_id,
        Experiment = variant_manifest$experiment[i],
        Donor = variant_manifest$donor[i],
        n_variants = nrow(meta),
        n_columns = ncol(meta),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}

variant_metadata_load_summary <- do.call(rbind, metadata_load_log)
rownames(variant_metadata_load_summary) <- NULL

print(variant_metadata_load_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```

# 4. Rename variants to gene-cDNA-AAchange

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Renaming NGT variant IDs to Gene_cDNA_protein
# ============================================================

# ---- Resolve column names tolerantly ------------------------------------------
pick_metadata_column <- function(meta, candidates, label, required = TRUE) {
    hit <- colnames(meta)[
        match(
            tolower(candidates),
            tolower(colnames(meta))
        )
    ]

    hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]

    if (length(hit) == 0) {
        if (!required) {
            return(NA_character_)
        }

        stop(
            "Could not find a '", label, "' column. Available: ",
            paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    hit[1]
}


# ---- Strip the Protein field to the p.-onwards part ---------------------------
# "PPM1D:p.N512Kfs*16" -> "p.N512Kfs*16"
# "COX10:p.p.?"        -> NA   (doubled prefix, uninformative)
# "SPECC1:p.S137="     -> "p.S137="
# ""                   -> NA
strip_protein_change <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(as.character(x))

    # Everything from the first "p." onwards.
    out <- sub("^.*?(p\\..*)$", "\\1", x, perl = TRUE)

    # No "p." present at all.
    out[!grepl("p\\.", x, perl = TRUE)] <- NA_character_

    # Collapse the doubled prefix seen in this export.
    out <- sub("^p\\.p\\.", "p.", out, perl = TRUE)

    # Uninformative or empty.
    out[is.na(x) | !nzchar(x)] <- NA_character_
    out[out %in% c("p.?", "p.", "p.NA")] <- NA_character_

    out
}


# ---- Build the Gene_cDNA_protein lookup for one sample ------------------------
build_variant_label_map <- function(meta) {
    if (!"variant_id" %in% colnames(meta)) {
        stop("Metadata table has no 'variant_id' column.")
    }

    gene_col <- pick_metadata_column(
        meta,
        c("Gene", "gene", "SYMBOL", "gene_name"),
        "Gene"
    )

    cdna_col <- pick_metadata_column(
        meta,
        c("cDNA", "cdna", "CDNA", "cDNA_change", "HGVSc"),
        "cDNA"
    )

    protein_col <- pick_metadata_column(
        meta,
        c("Protein", "protein", "AAchange", "aa_change", "HGVSp"),
        "Protein",
        required = FALSE
    )

    blank_to_na <- function(v) {
        v <- trimws(as.character(v))
        v[is.na(v) | v == "" | v == "NA"] <- NA_character_
        v
    }

    gene <- blank_to_na(meta[[gene_col]])
    cdna <- blank_to_na(meta[[cdna_col]])

    protein <- if (is.na(protein_col)) {
        rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta))
    } else {
        strip_protein_change(meta[[protein_col]])
    }

    # Gene and cDNA form the core label; protein is appended only when
    # informative, so variants without a usable p. change keep Gene_cDNA
    # rather than gaining an empty trailing underscore.
    core <- ifelse(
        is.na(gene) | is.na(cdna),
        NA_character_,
        paste0(gene, "_", cdna)
    )

    new_label <- ifelse(
        is.na(core),
        NA_character_,
        ifelse(
            is.na(protein),
            core,
            paste0(core, "_", protein)
        )
    )

    data.frame(
        variant_id = as.character(meta$variant_id),
        gene = gene,
        cdna = cdna,
        protein_raw = if (is.na(protein_col)) {
            NA_character_
        } else {
            as.character(meta[[protein_col]])
        },
        protein = protein,
        core_label = core,
        new_label = new_label,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}


# ---- Rename the variant axis of one NGT matrix --------------------------------
rename_ngt_variants <- function(ngt, meta, sample_id) {
    label_map <- build_variant_label_map(meta)

    n_row_match <- length(intersect(rownames(ngt), label_map$variant_id))
    n_col_match <- length(intersect(colnames(ngt), label_map$variant_id))

    if (n_row_match == 0 && n_col_match == 0) {
        stop(
            "No overlap between metadata variant_id and either axis of the ",
            "NGT matrix for ", sample_id, ". Example NGT rowname: ",
            rownames(ngt)[1], " | colname: ", colnames(ngt)[1],
            " | metadata variant_id: ", label_map$variant_id[1]
        )
    }

    variant_axis <- if (n_row_match >= n_col_match) "rows" else "columns"

    current_ids <- if (variant_axis == "rows") {
        rownames(ngt)
    } else {
        colnames(ngt)
    }

    idx <- match(current_ids, label_map$variant_id)

    proposed <- label_map$new_label[idx]

    # Unmatched or incomplete annotation: retain the original identifier.
    fallback <- is.na(idx) | is.na(proposed)
    proposed[fallback] <- current_ids[fallback]

    # Distinct variants can share a label (multi-allelic or duplicate panel
    # entries); make.unique appends .1, .2 rather than silently colliding.
    collisions <- proposed[duplicated(proposed)]
    final_ids <- make.unique(proposed, sep = ".")

    if (variant_axis == "rows") {
        rownames(ngt) <- final_ids
    } else {
        colnames(ngt) <- final_ids
    }

    matched <- !is.na(idx)

    list(
        matrix = ngt,
        axis = variant_axis,
        n_variants = length(current_ids),
        n_matched = sum(matched),
        n_unmatched = sum(!matched),
        n_missing_annotation = sum(matched & is.na(label_map$new_label[idx])),
        n_with_protein = sum(matched & !is.na(label_map$protein[idx])),
        n_without_protein = sum(
            matched &
                !is.na(label_map$core_label[idx]) &
                is.na(label_map$protein[idx])
        ),
        n_collisions = length(unique(collisions)),
        collisions = unique(collisions),
        id_map = data.frame(
            Sample = sample_id,
            original_id = current_ids,
            new_id = final_ids,
            matched = matched,
            gene = label_map$gene[idx],
            cdna = label_map$cdna[idx],
            protein_raw = label_map$protein_raw[idx],
            protein = label_map$protein[idx],
            core_label = label_map$core_label[idx],
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    )
}


# ---- Apply across all samples ------------------------------------------------
NGT_list_renamed <- setNames(
    vector("list", length(NGT_list)),
    names(NGT_list)
)

rename_log <- list()
variant_id_maps <- list()

for (sample_id in names(NGT_list)) {
    if (is.null(variant_metadata_list[[sample_id]])) {
        stop("No metadata loaded for ", sample_id)
    }

    message("Renaming variants for ", sample_id, " ...")

    result <- rename_ngt_variants(
        ngt = NGT_list[[sample_id]],
        meta = variant_metadata_list[[sample_id]],
        sample_id = sample_id
    )

    NGT_list_renamed[[sample_id]] <- result$matrix
    variant_id_maps[[sample_id]] <- result$id_map

    rename_log[[sample_id]] <- data.frame(
        Sample = sample_id,
        variant_axis = result$axis,
        n_variants = result$n_variants,
        n_matched = result$n_matched,
        n_unmatched = result$n_unmatched,
        n_missing_annotation = result$n_missing_annotation,
        n_with_protein = result$n_with_protein,
        n_without_protein = result$n_without_protein,
        n_collisions = result$n_collisions,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    if (result$n_collisions > 0) {
        message(
            "  ", result$n_collisions,
            " colliding label(s): ",
            paste(head(result$collisions, 5), collapse = ", "),
            if (result$n_collisions > 5) ", ..." else ""
        )
    }
}

variant_rename_summary <- do.call(rbind, rename_log)
rownames(variant_rename_summary) <- NULL

variant_id_map_long <- do.call(rbind, unname(variant_id_maps))
rownames(variant_id_map_long) <- NULL

print(variant_rename_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```

# 5. Keep only barcodes with protein data

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Restricting NGT matrices to cells present in `combined`
# ============================================================
# Two cell sets:
#   all cells     - every cell in `combined`
#   non-lymphoid  - `combined` minus mature T and B populations
#
# The lymphoid compartment is not expected to carry the myeloid clone, so
# including it dilutes single-cell VAF relative to bulk.

lymphoid_celltypes <- c(
    "CD8+ T cell",
    "CD4+ T cell",
    "B cell",
    "Other T cell"
)

celltype_column <- "Celltype_revised_refined"

stopifnot(celltype_column %in% colnames(combined[[]]))

combined_celltypes <- as.character(combined[[celltype_column, drop = TRUE]])
names(combined_celltypes) <- colnames(combined)

cells_all <- colnames(combined)

cells_non_lymphoid <- colnames(combined)[
    !is.na(combined_celltypes) &
        !combined_celltypes %in% lymphoid_celltypes
]

cat("Cell-type composition of `combined`:\n")
print(sort(table(combined_celltypes), decreasing = TRUE))

cat(
    "\nAll cells:", length(cells_all),
    "| Non-lymphoid:", length(cells_non_lymphoid),
    "| Excluded:", length(cells_all) - length(cells_non_lymphoid), "\n"
)

cat("Excluded populations:", paste(lymphoid_celltypes, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")


# ---- Filter every NGT matrix to a given cell set ------------------------------
filter_ngt_list <- function(ngt_list, keep_cells, set_label) {
    filtered <- setNames(vector("list", length(ngt_list)), names(ngt_list))
    filter_log <- list()

    for (sample_id in names(ngt_list)) {
        ngt <- ngt_list[[sample_id]]

        retained <- intersect(rownames(ngt), keep_cells)

        if (length(retained) == 0) {
            warning(
                "No cells retained for ", sample_id, " in set '", set_label,
                "' — example NGT barcode: ", rownames(ngt)[1],
                " | example target barcode: ", keep_cells[1]
            )
        }

        # drop = FALSE preserves matrix structure when a single cell survives.
        filtered[[sample_id]] <- ngt[retained, , drop = FALSE]

        filter_log[[sample_id]] <- data.frame(
            Sample = sample_id,
            cell_set = set_label,
            n_cells_before = nrow(ngt),
            n_cells_after = length(retained),
            n_dropped = nrow(ngt) - length(retained),
            pct_retained = round(100 * length(retained) / nrow(ngt), 1),
            n_variants = ncol(ngt),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    }

    summary_df <- do.call(rbind, filter_log)
    rownames(summary_df) <- NULL

    list(ngt_list = filtered, summary = summary_df)
}


# ---- Two explicitly named NGT lists ------------------------------------------
message("Filtering NGT matrices to all cells ...")

.res_all <- filter_ngt_list(NGT_list_renamed, cells_all, "all_cells")

message("Filtering NGT matrices to non-lymphoid cells ...")

.res_nl <- filter_ngt_list(
    NGT_list_renamed, cells_non_lymphoid, "non_lymphoid"
)

NGT_list_all_cells <- .res_all$ngt_list
NGT_list_non_lymphoid <- .res_nl$ngt_list

NGT_filter_summary <- rbind(.res_all$summary, .res_nl$summary)
rownames(NGT_filter_summary) <- NULL

print(NGT_filter_summary, row.names = FALSE)

cat(
    "\nAll cells   — NGT cells retained:",
    sum(.res_all$summary$n_cells_after),
    "of", sum(.res_all$summary$n_cells_before), "\n"
)

cat(
    "Non-lymphoid — NGT cells retained:",
    sum(.res_nl$summary$n_cells_after),
    "of", sum(.res_nl$summary$n_cells_before), "\n"
)

rm(.res_all, .res_nl)
```

# 6. Calculate pseudobulk VAFs

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Pseudobulk VAF from NGT genotypes (Tapestri convention)
# ============================================================
# NGT: 0 = WT, 1 = HET, 2 = HOM, 3 = missing / no-call
#
#   VAF          = (HET + 2 * HOM) / (2 * (WT + HET + HOM))
#   mutant cells = (HET + HOM)     /      (WT + HET + HOM)
#
# No-calls are excluded from the denominator, so VAF is conditional on a cell
# having been genotyped. Always read it alongside `pct_genotyped`.

compute_pseudobulk_vaf <- function(
    ngt,
    sample_id = NA_character_,
    group = NA_character_,
    min_genotyped = 1
) {
    if (is.null(ngt) || nrow(ngt) == 0 || ncol(ngt) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
    }

    storage.mode(ngt) <- "numeric"

    unexpected <- setdiff(unique(as.vector(ngt)), c(0, 1, 2, 3, NA))

    if (length(unexpected) > 0) {
        warning(
            "Unexpected NGT values (treated as missing): ",
            paste(head(unexpected, 10), collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    n_wt  <- colSums(ngt == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_het <- colSums(ngt == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_hom <- colSums(ngt == 2, na.rm = TRUE)

    n_genotyped <- n_wt + n_het + n_hom
    n_cells <- nrow(ngt)

    mut_alleles <- n_het + 2 * n_hom
    total_alleles <- 2 * n_genotyped

    vaf <- ifelse(total_alleles > 0, mut_alleles / total_alleles, NA_real_)

    mutant_cell_fraction <- ifelse(
        n_genotyped > 0, (n_het + n_hom) / n_genotyped, NA_real_
    )

    # Wilson interval — better behaved than Wald at the extremes.
    wilson_ci <- function(k, n, conf = 0.95) {
        z <- stats::qnorm(1 - (1 - conf) / 2)
        centre <- (k + z^2 / 2) / (n + z^2)
        half <- (z / (n + z^2)) * sqrt(k * (n - k) / n + z^2 / 4)
        cbind(lower = pmax(0, centre - half), upper = pmin(1, centre + half))
    }

    ci <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(vaf), ncol = 2)
    colnames(ci) <- c("lower", "upper")

    estimable <- total_alleles > 0
    ci[estimable, ] <- wilson_ci(mut_alleles[estimable], total_alleles[estimable])

    out <- data.frame(
        Sample = sample_id,
        Group = group,
        variant = colnames(ngt),
        n_cells = n_cells,
        n_genotyped = n_genotyped,
        n_missing = n_cells - n_genotyped,
        pct_genotyped = round(100 * n_genotyped / n_cells, 1),
        n_WT = n_wt,
        n_HET = n_het,
        n_HOM = n_hom,
        mut_alleles = mut_alleles,
        total_alleles = total_alleles,
        VAF = vaf,
        VAF_lower = ci[, "lower"],
        VAF_upper = ci[, "upper"],
        mutant_cell_fraction = mutant_cell_fraction,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    out$estimable <- out$n_genotyped >= min_genotyped
    rownames(out) <- NULL

    out
}


build_vaf_per_sample <- function(ngt_list, min_genotyped = 10) {
    res <- do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(names(ngt_list), function(s) {
            compute_pseudobulk_vaf(
                ngt_list[[s]], sample_id = s, min_genotyped = min_genotyped
            )
        })
    )

    if (is.null(res)) stop("No sample yielded a VAF table.")

    res <- res[order(res$Sample, -res$VAF), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(res) <- NULL

    res
}


vaf_per_sample_all_cells <- build_vaf_per_sample(NGT_list_all_cells, 10)
vaf_per_sample_non_lymphoid <- build_vaf_per_sample(NGT_list_non_lymphoid, 10)

cat(
    "All cells    — variant-sample pairs:", nrow(vaf_per_sample_all_cells),
    "| below threshold:", sum(!vaf_per_sample_all_cells$estimable), "\n"
)

cat(
    "Non-lymphoid — variant-sample pairs:", nrow(vaf_per_sample_non_lymphoid),
    "| below threshold:", sum(!vaf_per_sample_non_lymphoid$estimable), "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Normalise the AA change to the "p."-prefixed form produced by
# strip_protein_change(); "N/A" and blanks become NA and are omitted from
# the label, so splice variants keep the Gene_cDNA form.
normalise_aa_change <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(as.character(x))
    x[is.na(x) | x == "" | toupper(x) %in% c("NA", "N/A", "NONE", "?")] <- NA_character_

    ifelse(
        is.na(x),
        NA_character_,
        ifelse(grepl("^p\\.", x), x, paste0("p.", x))
    )
}
```

# 8. Annotate curated variants and add bulk VAFs

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Annotating curated variants with pseudobulk VAF
# ============================================================

normalise_label <- function(x) {
    gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(x))))
}

# ---- Resolve one curated label to a column in a sample's NGT matrix -----------
resolve_variant_column <- function(ngt_list, sample_id, variant_label) {
    ngt <- ngt_list[[sample_id]]

    if (is.null(ngt) || ncol(ngt) == 0) {
        return(list(column = NA_character_, match_type = "no_matrix"))
    }

    available <- colnames(ngt)

    idx <- match(variant_label, available)
    if (!is.na(idx)) {
        return(list(column = available[idx], match_type = "exact"))
    }

    idx <- match(normalise_label(variant_label), normalise_label(available))
    if (!is.na(idx)) {
        return(list(column = available[idx], match_type = "normalised"))
    }

    list(column = NA_character_, match_type = "none")
}


# ---- Per-row genotype counts and VAF for one NGT list -------------------------
annotate_curated_with_vaf <- function(ngt_list, curated, min_genotyped = 10) {
    vaf_columns <- do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(seq_len(nrow(curated)), function(i) {
            sample_id <- curated$sample_id[i]
            label <- curated$variant_label[i]

            hit <- resolve_variant_column(ngt_list, sample_id, label)

            empty_row <- data.frame(
                matched_column = hit$column,
                match_type = hit$match_type,
                n_cells = NA_integer_,
                n_genotyped = NA_integer_,
                pct_genotyped = NA_real_,
                n_WT = NA_integer_,
                n_HET = NA_integer_,
                n_HOM = NA_integer_,
                n_missing = NA_integer_,
                VAF = NA_real_,
                VAF_lower = NA_real_,
                VAF_upper = NA_real_,
                mutant_cell_fraction = NA_real_,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )

            if (is.na(hit$column)) return(empty_row)

            g <- ngt_list[[sample_id]][, hit$column]
            g <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(g))

            n_cells <- length(g)
            n_wt <- sum(g == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
            n_het <- sum(g == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
            n_hom <- sum(g == 2, na.rm = TRUE)

            n_genotyped <- n_wt + n_het + n_hom
            mut_alleles <- n_het + 2 * n_hom
            total_alleles <- 2 * n_genotyped

            if (total_alleles > 0) {
                z <- stats::qnorm(0.975)
                centre <- (mut_alleles + z^2 / 2) / (total_alleles + z^2)
                half <- (z / (total_alleles + z^2)) *
                    sqrt(
                        mut_alleles * (total_alleles - mut_alleles) /
                            total_alleles + z^2 / 4
                    )

                vaf <- mut_alleles / total_alleles
                lo <- max(0, centre - half)
                hi <- min(1, centre + half)
            } else {
                vaf <- NA_real_; lo <- NA_real_; hi <- NA_real_
            }

            empty_row$n_cells <- n_cells
            empty_row$n_genotyped <- as.integer(n_genotyped)
            empty_row$pct_genotyped <- if (n_cells > 0) {
                round(100 * n_genotyped / n_cells, 1)
            } else NA_real_
            empty_row$n_WT <- as.integer(n_wt)
            empty_row$n_HET <- as.integer(n_het)
            empty_row$n_HOM <- as.integer(n_hom)
            empty_row$n_missing <- as.integer(n_cells - n_genotyped)
            empty_row$VAF <- vaf * 100
            empty_row$VAF_lower <- lo * 100
            empty_row$VAF_upper <- hi * 100
            empty_row$mutant_cell_fraction <- if (n_genotyped > 0) {
                (n_het + n_hom) / n_genotyped
            } else NA_real_

            empty_row
        })
    )

    out <- cbind(curated, vaf_columns)
    rownames(out) <- NULL

    names(out)[names(out) == "bulk"] <- "bulkDNA"

    stopifnot(
        all(c("bulkDNA", "scDNA") %in% colnames(out)),
        !anyDuplicated(colnames(out))
    )

    out$Recovered_here <- ifelse(is.na(out$matched_column), "No", "Yes")

    # With the non-lymphoid subset the denominator is smaller, so this
    # flag will fire more often.
    out$estimable <- !is.na(out$n_genotyped) & out$n_genotyped >= min_genotyped

    out
}


curated_variants_vaf_all_cells <- annotate_curated_with_vaf(
    NGT_list_all_cells, curated_variants, 10
)

curated_variants_vaf_non_lymphoid <- annotate_curated_with_vaf(
    NGT_list_non_lymphoid, curated_variants, 10
)

for (set_label in c("all_cells", "non_lymphoid")) {
    tab <- get(paste0("curated_variants_vaf_", set_label))

    cat("\n=====================================================\n")
    cat("Cell set: ", set_label, "\n", sep = "")
    cat("=====================================================\n")

    print(
        tab[
            , c("sample_id", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change",
                "bulkDNA", "scDNA", "Recovered_here",
                "n_cells", "n_genotyped", "pct_genotyped",
                "n_WT", "n_HET", "n_HOM", "VAF", "mutant_cell_fraction",
                "match_type", "estimable")
        ],
        row.names = FALSE,
        digits = 3
    )

    cat("\nReported scDNA status vs recovery in this pipeline:\n")
    print(table(Reported = tab$scDNA, Recovered = tab$Recovered_here))
}
```

```{r}
# ---- Selected columns, with bulk VAF joined on -------------------------------
build_selected_columns <- function(vaf_table) {
    out <- vaf_table[
        , c("sample_id", "variant_label", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change",
            "VAF", "bulkDNA", "scDNA")
    ]

    rownames(out) <- NULL

    names(out)[names(out) == "VAF"] <- "scVAF"

    curated_keys <- paste(out$sample_id, out$variant_label)

    # Every bulk entry must correspond to a curated row, or the label is wrong.
    orphaned <- bulk_vaf_table[!bulk_keys %in% curated_keys, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(orphaned) > 0) {
        stop(
            "Bulk entries with no matching curated row:\n",
            paste(orphaned$sample_id, orphaned$variant_label, collapse = "\n")
        )
    }

    out$bulkVAF <- bulk_vaf_table$bulkVAF[match(curated_keys, bulk_keys)]

    out[
        , c("sample_id", "variant_label", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change",
            "scVAF", "bulkVAF", "bulkDNA", "scDNA")
    ]
}


# ==== THE TWO TABLES ==========================================================
curated_vaf_all_cells <- build_selected_columns(curated_variants_vaf_all_cells)
curated_vaf_non_lymphoid <- build_selected_columns(curated_variants_vaf_non_lymphoid)

cat("\n===== scVAF, all cells =====\n")
print(curated_vaf_all_cells, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

cat("\n===== scVAF, non-lymphoid =====\n")
print(curated_vaf_non_lymphoid, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)


# ==== SIDE-BY-SIDE COMPARISON =================================================
stopifnot(identical(
    paste(curated_vaf_all_cells$sample_id, curated_vaf_all_cells$variant_label),
    paste(curated_vaf_non_lymphoid$sample_id, curated_vaf_non_lymphoid$variant_label)
))

curated_vaf_comparison <- data.frame(
    sample_id = curated_vaf_all_cells$sample_id,
    variant_label = curated_vaf_all_cells$variant_label,
    gene = curated_vaf_all_cells$gene,
    cdna = curated_vaf_all_cells$cdna,
    aa_change = curated_vaf_all_cells$aa_change,
    scVAF_all_cells = curated_vaf_all_cells$scVAF,
    scVAF_non_lymphoid = curated_vaf_non_lymphoid$scVAF,
    bulkVAF = curated_vaf_all_cells$bulkVAF,
    bulkDNA = curated_vaf_all_cells$bulkDNA,
    scDNA = curated_vaf_all_cells$scDNA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

curated_vaf_comparison$delta <-
    curated_vaf_comparison$scVAF_non_lymphoid -
    curated_vaf_comparison$scVAF_all_cells

cat("\n===== all cells vs non-lymphoid, side by side =====\n")
print(curated_vaf_comparison, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

comparable <- curated_vaf_comparison[
    !grepl("_FU$", curated_vaf_comparison$sample_id) &
        !is.na(curated_vaf_comparison$delta), ,
    drop = FALSE
]

cat(
    "\nMedian change after excluding lymphoid cells:",
    round(median(comparable$delta, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "percentage points",
    "| increased:", sum(comparable$delta > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    "| decreased:", sum(comparable$delta < 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n"
)
```

# 9. Plotting

```{r}
# ============================================================
# scVAF vs bulkVAF scatter (baseline samples only)
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(ggplot2)
    library(dplyr)
})

excluded_genes <- c("GATA2", "SRSF2", "CEBPA", "ASXL1")

detection_colours <- c(
    "Both"       = "#4D4D4D",
    "scDNA only" = "#009E73",
    "Bulk only"  = "#0072B2"
)

save_dir <- "/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/results/figures"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# ---- Build one scatter from a selected-columns table --------------------------
build_vaf_scatter <- function(vaf_table, y_axis_label, set_label) {

    # ---- 1. Baseline only, excluded genes dropped, NA -> 0 -------------------
    # row_id is assigned here so residuals fitted on the "Both" subset can be
    # joined back onto the full plotting table without relying on row order.
    vaf_plot_df <- vaf_table %>%
        filter(
            !grepl("_FU$", sample_id),
            !gene %in% excluded_genes
        ) %>%
        mutate(
            detected_sc = !is.na(scVAF),
            detected_bulk = !is.na(bulkVAF),
            scVAF_plot = ifelse(is.na(scVAF), 0, scVAF),
            bulkVAF_plot = ifelse(is.na(bulkVAF), 0, bulkVAF),
            detection = case_when(
                detected_sc & detected_bulk ~ "Both",
                detected_sc & !detected_bulk ~ "scDNA only",
                !detected_sc & detected_bulk ~ "Bulk only",
                TRUE ~ "Neither"
            )
        ) %>%
        filter(detection != "Neither") %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number())

    cat("\n[", set_label, "] points by detection category:\n", sep = "")
    print(table(vaf_plot_df$detection))

    # ---- 2. Linear fit on shared points only --------------------------------
    shared <- vaf_plot_df %>% filter(detection == "Both")

    fit <- lm(scVAF ~ bulkVAF, data = shared)
    fit_summary <- summary(fit)

    r2 <- fit_summary$r.squared
    p_value <- fit_summary$coefficients["bulkVAF", "Pr(>|t|)"]

    # ---- 2b. Residuals, "Both" variants only --------------------------------
    # Only variants detected on both platforms sit on the regression, so
    # residuals are defined for those alone. shared carries no NAs in either
    # VAF column, so lm rows align 1:1 with it.
    #
    # residual_sd is the residual standard error of the fit, constant across
    # rows within a cell set. residual_stud is rstudent(): residual scaled by
    # a leave-one-out sigma and corrected for leverage, so it is close to but
    # not exactly residual / residual_sd.
    residual_cols <- shared %>%
        mutate(
            fitted = as.numeric(fitted(fit)),
            residual = as.numeric(residuals(fit)),
            residual_stud = as.numeric(rstudent(fit))
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(row_id, fitted, residual, residual_stud)

    # Join back: scDNA-only and Bulk-only rows get NA, since a variant seen on
    # one platform only has no fitted counterpart on the regression.
    vaf_plot_df <- vaf_plot_df %>%
        left_join(residual_cols, by = "row_id")

    # Standalone residual table for export and inspection.
    residual_df <- vaf_plot_df %>%
        filter(detection == "Both") %>%
        mutate(cell_set = set_label) %>%
        dplyr::select(
            cell_set,
            dplyr::any_of(c("sample_id", "gene", "variant", "id")),
            bulkVAF, scVAF, residual, residual_stud
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(abs(residual_stud)))

    cat(
        "Linear fit on", nrow(shared), "shared variants:",
        "R2 =", round(r2, 3),
        "| slope =", round(coef(fit)["bulkVAF"], 3),
        "| p =", format.pval(p_value, digits = 3),
        "| Spearman rho =",
        round(cor(shared$scVAF, shared$bulkVAF, method = "spearman"), 3),
        "| residual SD =", round(fit_summary$sigma, 3), "\n"
    )

    write.csv(
        residual_df,
        file.path(
            save_dir, paste0("scVAF_vs_bulkVAF_residuals_", set_label, ".csv")
        ),
        row.names = FALSE
    )

    label_text <- paste0(
        "R\u00b2 = ", format(round(r2, 3), nsmall = 3), "\n",
        "p = ",
        if (p_value < 0.0001) {
            format(p_value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
        } else {
            format(round(p_value, 4), nsmall = 4)
        },
        "\nn = ", nrow(shared)
    )

    # ---- 3. Markers as data-space polygons ----------------------------------
    # Point size in mm and ring radius in data units cannot stay matched
    # across devices, so markers are polygons in data coordinates.
    axis_max <- max(
        c(vaf_plot_df$scVAF_plot, vaf_plot_df$bulkVAF_plot), na.rm = TRUE
    )

    axis_limit <- ceiling(axis_max / 10) * 10

    marker_radius <- axis_limit * 0.0135
    border_width <- 0.6

    circle_polygon <- function(x, y, r, id, n = 90) {
        theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n)
        data.frame(
            x = x + r * cos(theta),
            y = y + r * sin(theta),
            marker_id = id
        )
    }

    marker_polygons <- do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(seq_len(nrow(vaf_plot_df)), function(i) {
            poly <- circle_polygon(
                vaf_plot_df$bulkVAF_plot[i],
                vaf_plot_df$scVAF_plot[i],
                marker_radius,
                id = i
            )
            poly$detection <- vaf_plot_df$detection[i]
            poly
        })
    )

    # Draw higher markers first so lower ones are not hidden beneath them.
    draw_order <- order(-vaf_plot_df$scVAF_plot)

    marker_polygons$marker_id <- factor(
        marker_polygons$marker_id, levels = draw_order
    )

    poly_both <- marker_polygons %>% filter(detection == "Both")
    poly_single <- marker_polygons %>% filter(detection != "Both")

    # ---- 4. Plot ------------------------------------------------------------
    threshold_label <- "2% VAF"

    p <- ggplot() +
        # Only the hline contributes to the legend key; the vline is drawn
        # with show.legend = FALSE so the key is a single horizontal line.
        geom_hline(
            aes(yintercept = 2, linetype = threshold_label),
            colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.7
        ) +
        geom_vline(
            aes(xintercept = 2, linetype = threshold_label),
            colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE
        ) +
        scale_linetype_manual(
            values = setNames("dashed", threshold_label), name = NULL
        ) +
        geom_abline(
            slope = coef(fit)["bulkVAF"],
            intercept = coef(fit)["(Intercept)"],
            colour = "#d62728", linewidth = 0.8
        ) +
        # Detected in both: solid border.
        geom_polygon(
            data = poly_both,
            aes(x = x, y = y, group = marker_id, fill = detection),
            colour = "black", linewidth = border_width, linetype = "solid"
        ) +
        # One platform only: dashed border, same size and fill.
        geom_polygon(
            data = poly_single,
            aes(x = x, y = y, group = marker_id, fill = detection),
            colour = "black", linewidth = border_width, linetype = "dashed"
        ) +
        # Invisible layer purely to generate the fill legend; linetype set
        # explicitly so the key does not inherit the dashed threshold style.
        geom_point(
            data = vaf_plot_df,
            aes(x = bulkVAF_plot, y = scVAF_plot, fill = detection),
            shape = 21, size = 0, stroke = 0, alpha = 0, linetype = "solid"
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
            values = detection_colours,
            breaks = c("Both", "scDNA only", "Bulk only"),
            name = NULL
        ) +
        annotate(
            "text",
            x = axis_limit * 0.97, y = axis_limit * 0.97,
            label = label_text, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
            size = 3.6, family = "sans", lineheight = 1.15
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Bulk VAF (%)",
            limits = c(-axis_limit * 0.04, axis_limit),
            breaks = seq(0, axis_limit, by = 20),
            expand = c(0, 0)
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(
            name = y_axis_label,
            limits = c(-axis_limit * 0.04, axis_limit),
            breaks = seq(0, axis_limit, by = 20),
            expand = c(0, 0)
        ) +
        coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
        theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "sans") +
        theme(
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            axis.ticks.length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
            axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
            axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.direction = "horizontal",
            legend.box = "horizontal",
            legend.box.just = "center",
            legend.justification = "center",
            legend.spacing.x = unit(0.6, "cm"),
            legend.box.spacing = unit(0.35, "cm"),
            legend.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2),
            legend.background = element_blank(),
            legend.key = element_blank(),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
            legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
            plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 4, 8)
        ) +
        guides(
            fill = guide_legend(
                order = 1, nrow = 1,
                override.aes = list(
                    shape = 21, size = 4.2, stroke = 0.7,
                    alpha = 1, colour = "black", linetype = "solid"
                )
            ),
            linetype = guide_legend(
                order = 2, nrow = 1,
                override.aes = list(
                    colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.7,
                    shape = NA, fill = NA
                )
            )
        )

    # ---- 5. Residual diagnostic --------------------------------------------
    resid_plot_df <- vaf_plot_df %>% filter(detection == "Both")

    resid_limit <- max(abs(resid_plot_df$residual_stud)) * 1.1

    p_resid <- ggplot(resid_plot_df, aes(x = fitted, y = residual_stud)) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#d62728", linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_point(
            shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.6,
            colour = "black", fill = detection_colours[["Both"]]
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(
            name = "Studentised residual",
            limits = c(-resid_limit, resid_limit)
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(name = "Fitted single-cell VAF (%)") +
        theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "sans") +
        theme(
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            axis.ticks.length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
            axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
            axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 4, 8)
        )

    list(
        plot = p, residual_plot = p_resid, data = vaf_plot_df,
        fit = fit, residuals = residual_df,
        r2 = r2, p_value = p_value, n_shared = nrow(shared)
    )
}


# ==== PLOT 1: all cells =======================================================
res_all_cells <- build_vaf_scatter(
    vaf_table = curated_vaf_all_cells,
    y_axis_label = "Single-cell VAF, all cells (%)",
    set_label = "all_cells"
)

p_all_cells <- res_all_cells$plot

print(p_all_cells)

# Extra height absorbs the bottom legend so the panel stays square.
ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, "scVAF_all_cells_vs_bulkVAF.pdf"),
    plot = p_all_cells, width = 5.2, height = 6.0, device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, "scVAF_all_cells_vs_bulkVAF.png"),
    plot = p_all_cells, width = 5.2, height = 6.0, dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, "scVAF_all_cells_vs_bulkVAF_residuals.pdf"),
    plot = res_all_cells$residual_plot,
    width = 5.2, height = 4.2, device = cairo_pdf
)


# ==== PLOT 2: non-lymphoid ====================================================
res_non_lymphoid <- build_vaf_scatter(
    vaf_table = curated_vaf_non_lymphoid,
    y_axis_label = "Single-cell VAF, non-lymphoid (%)",
    set_label = "non_lymphoid"
)

p_non_lymphoid <- res_non_lymphoid$plot

print(p_non_lymphoid)

ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, "scVAF_non_lymphoid_vs_bulkVAF.pdf"),
    plot = p_non_lymphoid, width = 5.2, height = 6.0, device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, "scVAF_non_lymphoid_vs_bulkVAF.png"),
    plot = p_non_lymphoid, width = 5.2, height = 6.0, dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, "scVAF_non_lymphoid_vs_bulkVAF_residuals.pdf"),
    plot = res_non_lymphoid$residual_plot,
    width = 5.2, height = 4.2, device = cairo_pdf
)


# ---- Fit comparison -----------------------------------------------------------
fit_comparison <- data.frame(
    cell_set = c("all_cells", "non_lymphoid"),
    n_shared = c(res_all_cells$n_shared, res_non_lymphoid$n_shared),
    R2 = round(c(res_all_cells$r2, res_non_lymphoid$r2), 3),
    slope = round(
        c(coef(res_all_cells$fit)["bulkVAF"],
          coef(res_non_lymphoid$fit)["bulkVAF"]), 3
    ),
    intercept = round(
        c(coef(res_all_cells$fit)["(Intercept)"],
          coef(res_non_lymphoid$fit)["(Intercept)"]), 3
    ),
    p_value = c(
        format.pval(res_all_cells$p_value, digits = 3),
        format.pval(res_non_lymphoid$p_value, digits = 3)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("\nRegression fits by cell set:\n")
print(fit_comparison, row.names = FALSE)


# ---- Combined residual table --------------------------------------------------
all_residuals <- bind_rows(
    res_all_cells$residuals,
    res_non_lymphoid$residuals
)

write.csv(
    all_residuals,
    file.path(save_dir, "scVAF_vs_bulkVAF_residuals_combined.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
)
```
